name: Baltimore County Summer Youth Employment Program
org: Baltimore County Department of Economic and Workforce Development

offerings.cycle_label: Summer 2024 - the last cycle the county has published
offerings.summary: Baltimore County placed youths aged fourteen to twenty-one in paid summer jobs at fifteen dollars an hour for up to twenty-five hours a week, from 1 July to 9 August; the county's page has not been updated since that cycle closed.

items.raw: earning $15 an hour for up to 25 hours per week

app.instructions: Subscribe to the county's Youth Connections newsletter for the next cycle's opening.

issues: The county's own page still carries the 2024 cycle and states applications are no longer accepted; no 2027 cycle has been announced. The 2024 details are kept as the best predictor of the next cycle.
